title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Practice: Parallel Line Angle Theorems
description: Practice using parallel-line angle relationships to find missing measures.

questions.question: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If one angle is $68^\circ$, its corresponding angle measures:
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are congruent when parallel lines are cut by a transversal.

questions.question: Two same-side interior angles formed by parallel lines measure $73^\circ$ and $x^\circ$. What is $x$?
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles are supplementary, so $x = 180 - 73 = 107$.

questions.question: Alternate interior angles are congruent when the two lines cut by the transversal are parallel.
questions.explanation: For parallel lines, alternate interior angles have equal measures.

questions.question: A linear pair contains one angle measuring $124^\circ$. The other angle measures ______ degrees.
questions.explanation: Angles in a linear pair are supplementary, so $180 - 124 = 56$.

questions.question: Which relationship can be used to justify that two angles on opposite outside regions of parallel lines are congruent?
questions.explanation: Alternate exterior angles lie outside the parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal, and they are congruent.

questions.question: If $m\angle 1 = 42^\circ$ and $\angle 1$ and $\angle 2$ are vertical angles, then $m\angle 2 = $ ______ degrees.
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are congruent, so they have equal measures.

questions.question: Parallel lines are cut by a transversal. $m\angle A = 118^\circ$. Angle B is alternate interior to angle A. Find $m\angle B$ and name the relationship.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle B = 118^\circ$ because alternate interior angles are congruent.
questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so the measure is copied exactly.

questions.question: An angle is $35^\circ$. A second angle forms a same-side interior pair with it on parallel lines. Find the second angle and justify your answer.
questions.correctAnswer: The second angle is $145^\circ$ because same-side interior angles are supplementary, and $180 - 35 = 145$.
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles add to 180° when the lines are parallel.
